name: GDCToken sell burn exceeds forwarded amount, with reentrant tax-free exit
summary: On a taxed GDC sell, swapSellAward forwards only 30% of the sold amount to the pair but _burnSellAgainstPair then burns the full nominal amount out of the pair's reserve and syncs; the sell body runs with swapping = true, and the referral reward is paid mid-body with a raw BNB call, during which transfers into the pair skip the tax branch. Helpers that deposited from their constructors (defeating the extcodesize EOA check) could buy from the pair because the token classifies pair outflows to depositors as liquidity removals. The attacker sold 221.24M GDC to collapse the GDC reserve and, inside the referral callbacks, dumped a pre-bought 1.63B GDC bag tax-free, netting 35.34 WBNB from the GDC/WBNB pair.
notes: Direct immutable GDCToken; owner parameter changes after deployment (deposit bounds, node levels) do not affect the exploit in replay, and the inviter migration batches are user-state import.

WBNB the GDC/WBNB pair 0x9cd8d04c30ed78afef7ed00ab1a2a028d476331c paid to the attacker's contracts net of the WBNB they paid into it, less the attacker's 0.2 BNB of helper deposits into GDC; it equals the 35.33715149597698649 WBNB forwarded to the attacker (Moolah flash loan at 0% fee). The pair's total WBNB drop was 38.136252429986871143; the other 2.799 WBNB are GDC's own tax swap-back routed to the company, referral and liquidity paths and are not attributed to the attacker.
